name: al-Awwam ibn Hawshab
nameAr: العوام بن حوشب بن يزيد الشيباني، أبو عيسى، الواسطي

orthography.spelled: Hawshab: ha' without a dot, then shin, on the pattern of Ja'far
orthography.source: Ibn Hajar, Fath al-Bari on hadith 2996

students.name: Hushaym ibn Bashir
students.source: Sunan Abi Dawud 3091; al-Isma'ili's Mustakhraj as cited in Fath al-Bari on 2996

verdicts.ar: شيباني من أنفسهم، ثقة صاحب سنة، ثبت صالح
verdicts.en: A Shaybani by descent; reliable, a man of the Sunnah, firm and righteous.

dhahabi.source: al-Kashif, as given on the Shamela record

flags.label: Named without nasab in hadith 2996
flags.detail: Al-Bukhari writes only “al-Awwam”. Ibn Hajar identifies him as Ibn Hawshab in Fath al-Bari; the Hady al-Sari discussion of hadith 2996 treats him as the narrator who alone carried the report as a connected, Prophetic hadith (musnad), against Mis'ar, who stopped it at Abu Burdah.

flags.label: Tribal Shaybani, not a client
flags.detail: Al-Ijli: a Shaybani “of themselves” (by descent); his father served in al-Hajjaj's police (Tahdhib al-Tahdhib 3/334).

bio: A Wasiti of the sixth generation, praised by Ibn Ma'in, Abu Zur'ah, al-Ijli and Ibn Sa'd, and used by all six compilers. He is the hinge of hadith 2996: al-Daraqutni noted that he alone gave the report a connected chain to the Prophet ﷺ, and Ibn Hajar defended him on the strength of the travel story that frames the report.

sources.label: Ibn Hajar, Fath al-Bari on hadith 2996 (islamweb)
